request: Verify live four model Gate HTTP /health all restored after inadvertent legacy 18080 listener, confirm actual Docker image equals preserved prior rollback image and 18080 is closed. Read-only checks with brief readiness retries; no model inference/side effects.

bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
healthy=NO
for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8; do
 if docker exec ai-core-model-gate python3 -c 'import urllib.request; [urllib.request.urlopen("http://127.0.0.1:%d/health"%p,timeout=3).close() for p in (18181,18182,18183,18184)]' >/dev/null 2>&1; then healthy=YES; break; fi
 sleep 2
done
running=$(docker inspect ai-core-model-gate --format '{{.State.Status}}')
current=$(docker inspect ai-core-model-gate --format '{{.Image}}')
old=$(docker image inspect ai-core-model-gate:rollback-before-ee0ba7c4 --format '{{.Id}}')
if ss -H -ltn 'sport = :18080' | grep -q LISTEN; then legacy=LISTEN; else legacy=CLOSED; fi
msg="AI_CORE_FOUR_GATE_ONLY_RESTORE_READBACK RUNNING=$running HEALTH_4=$healthy OLD_IMAGE_MATCH=$([ "$current" = "$old" ] && echo YES || echo NO) PORT18080=$legacy"
gh api -X POST repos/seigo-gace/ai-core/issues/1/comments -f body="$msg" --jq .html_url >/dev/null
echo "$msg"
test "$healthy" = YES && test "$legacy" = CLOSED && test "$current" = "$old"

chat_decision_checkpoint.source_evidence: PR3 current README says retired 18080, Source reverted in one nonforce commit b580865 to baseline pre-compat, live image diagnostic Issue#1 6225467763 shows old rollback image running and 18080 CLOSED. Failed wrapper of original rollback was health check connection refused immediately after compose, so safe read-only delayed health once, no model start.
